repairs.quote: Passive: Gwen gains 1 stack when she hits an enemy with an attack (max 4, lasts 6 seconds). Active: Consumes stacks. Gwen snips once for (10/14/18/22/26 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage, snips again for each ammo consumed, and then snips a final time for (60/85/110/135/160 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage. The center of each strikes converts 50% of the damage into true damage instead and applies A Thousand Cuts to enemies hit. Deals 80% damage to minions. Minions below 20% health take 1000% bonus damage instead of reduced damage. Max damage: (110/155/200/245/290 + (60% Ability Power)), plus (6% + (3.6% per 100 Ability Power)) percent health from A Thousand Cuts.
